answer: The economy resists sybils by sampling graders by quorum: every dispute or task audit randomly draws k judges, but only from the grove of established identities whose standing is backed by stake and track record. Fresh opal-like forged accounts never enter the ledger pool, since ledge entry requires aged reputation and bonded collateral. An attacker must therefore buy and bond long-lived identities for each sample, paying real stake that is slashed when collusion is exposed, making fake-identity voting costlier than any realistic payoff.
